data.long_meaning: The name Rosco is derived from the Latin word ‘ros’ which means ‘red’. The suffix ‘co’ means ‘having’ or ‘companion of’. This name was commonly given to red-haired men, as well as those who were rough and tumble in nature. The name Rosco carries the meaning “Rough, Red-haired” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rosco usually hope their child will grow to embody rough, red-haired and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name Rosco was often given to those with red hair, as it would reflect their appearance. This name also carried the connotation of a rugged or tough individual, which further reinforced its reputation. Over time, the name Rosco came to symbolize strength, vitality, and fearlessness.
